summary: Frontend-only UX regression for VoteSecure iteration 4. Verified privacy nav scroll-to-top on desktop (1440) and mobile (390) via the public home 'Read the details' link (scrollY=0, heading 'Privacy & election rules' visible both viewports). Verified mobile Login nav flow at 390x844: hamburger -> nav-login-btn in sheet opens /login with no leftover sheet/overlay (open sheets=0); login-identifier-input and login-password-input accept typed input immediately (id='testuser@example.com', pw_len=16); after a failed login (Invalid credentials shown) form is still usable and retype succeeds. Register name validation: 'Hriata Khuptong', 'Hriata-Khuptong', "O'Connor", and 'José Ángel' all accepted (Registration submitted screen reached); 'Hriata123' and 'Hriata@' both blocked inline with 'Letters, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens only' and no submission. Semester dropdown contains exactly Select… + 1..6 (7 options total). Admin Security Command Center at /app/admin/security loads with real data: 4 category cards (failed_logins=14/14, rate_limits=0/0, unauthorized=4/4, suspicious=1/1), audit-chain integrity Verified (61 events), locked accounts 0, system health Active (DB 0.2ms, 8 sessions), reconciliation-discrepancies empty section, and security-events-table with 20+ event rows (timestamp, kind, severity, hashed source, detail, recommended action) — hashes shown instead of raw emails, no ballot choices or passwords exposed. Non-admin student (self-registered QA-WYCNV2) hitting /app/admin/security is redirected to /app/student with 0 occurrences of security-center-page. Hero regression: ICFAI campus-building.jpg loads (naturalWidth=1536), 'Secure Elections. Trusted Results.' heading + Get started + Sign in buttons + 'Built and developed by Hriata_khuptong' footer credit all present. Signed report downloads: ResultsTab.jsx code confirms data-testid results-pdf-btn, results-csv-btn, and reconciliation-pdf-{id} wiring to downloadReport() hitting /results/{eid}/report.pdf, /results/{eid}/report.csv, /elections/{eid}/reconciliations/{rid}/report.pdf — but preview DB currently has only one Draft election ('Sport'), zero closed/finalized/published, so the buttons are intentionally not yet rendered in UI. Did NOT fabricate a synthetic closed election; backend endpoints already have 36/36 pytest coverage per iteration_3.
action_items: No fix required. Signed PDF/CSV download buttons could not be exercised in-browser because the preview DB has no closed/finalized election right now. Code paths and testids are present and backend endpoints are already pytest-verified. If an end-to-end browser click test is desired for a future iteration, create a short-lived synthetic election (open->close->reconcile->finalize) via the UI or seed script and click results-pdf-btn / results-csv-btn / reconciliation-pdf-{id}.
critical_code_review_comments: ResultsTab downloadReport() swallows errors with a toast only — acceptable but a console.warn with error payload would help field debugging when the signed report endpoint returns 4xx.
Register name regex (Unicode letters + spaces + apostrophes + hyphens) correctly rejects digits/@. Nice. No change needed.

Public hero image heading 'Secure Elections. Trusted Results.' wraps across two lines; a single-line text matcher won't find it. Non-blocking, but if main agent writes future E2E, use get_by_role('heading') or match by partial text.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All seven features from the review request pass. Several QA-* student rows (semester 6, pending verification) remain in preview DB from the register-name-validation test; they are harmless but can be deleted via db.users.delete_many({'reg_number': {'$regex': '^QA-'}}) if clean state needed. Only remaining untested-via-browser area: actual file-download behaviour of results-pdf-btn / results-csv-btn / reconciliation-pdf-{id} — would need a closed+reconciled election first.
